# Version 4.154.0
> **m154 and XML docs** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and ships compiler-generated XML documentation with its packages. HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source; review the enum migrations below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed** — The misspelled CCC133 member is corrected to CCC132 while retaining numeric value 132. Update source code that references CCC133 to use CCC132 instead.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined removed** — The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags your application requires directly; the analogous BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined members are not added.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through Chrome m154 servicing** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates upstream rendering and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation shipped** — NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with API descriptions maintained alongside the C# declarations. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings now generate from the HarfBuzz revision bundled by Skia, keeping supported declarations synchronized with the native library.
